formulaImportValidation: ODS namespace/cache corrections and CSV calculation. Changed XLSX cell values checked against LibreOffice 24.8.7.2. CSV values checked against native CSV or existing XLSX snapshots; this does not establish native parity for the retained evaluator. Six matrix-empty CSV fields display zero where native CSV is blank. Formula serialization retains existing quoting/case/union differences. Unknown MISSING function export spelling independently checked with LibreOffice 24.8.7.2: missing(1), cache #NAME?.

emptyValueValidation.note: Changed CSV fields and cached values independently compared with native exports before refreshing; aggregate and array empty-value handling, INDEX spans and CSV numeric precision. Unmodified production expectations remain.

csvQuotingValidation: Delimiter/quote-aware CSV escaping verified with LibreOffice 24.8.7.2. Legacy Text filter aliases use equivalent explicit native delimiter, quote, UTF-8 and quote-all=false options. Existing CR/CRLF cell contents remain unchanged; native exports normalize these to LF. rich-inheritance, rich-nested-link and legacy-generic use equivalent plain-cell inputs to isolate quoting from their existing import differences.
referenceListOrderValidation: LibreOffice 24.8.7.2 verifies changed calculation caches. Sheet-reference spelling is checked against native exports and native reimports of old/new XLSX. Existing ODS name-scope/base, reversed-range and SHEET/SHEETS spelling differences remain; unrelated XML structure and package parts are unchanged.
exportMetadataValidation: LibreOffice 24.8.7.2 controls validate exporter identity, disabled default iteration, omitted synthetic names and lowercase unknown Gnumeric functions. Other archive parts and cell data match the prior snapshot, apart from 75 independently verified unknown-function controls in soffice-ods-references.json.
archiveMetadata: Content-focused cases include a root manifest entry matching their ODS/SXC MIME; deliberately invalid archives retain their original bytes.
archiveAdmissionValidation: Malformed OpenDocument metadata rejects with status zero and preserves output, matching fresh LibreOffice 24.8.7.2 captures. Other format/rendering expectations retain their existing references.
nativeExportValidation: LibreOffice 24.8.7.2: explicit Writer Text filter refuses Calc export; default spreadsheet export refuses Writer input. Source parts retained unchanged.

nativeTextGaps.truncated.ods: Native imports the truncated ZIP as Writer text. Default spreadsheet export now refuses correctly; explicit Text export still returns a bounded ZIP error instead of binary-text output.

cachePrecisionParity.reference: Stored numeric values retain full Rust calculation precision. Each changed cache was checked against the previous native expectation by exact 15/17-significant-digit decimal rounding; all other XML and direct CSV outputs are unchanged. Exact CSV, ODS and reopened-XLSX values are independently covered by soffice-numeric-cell-precision-production.json.

emptyDocumentCoverage: Empty/malformed document cases are covered by soffice-ods-empty-production.json, recaptured through public runSofficeFileCli for CSV and XLSX.

csvProductionParity.source: Fresh public runSofficeFileCli captures, 2026-11-21. Exact status, stdout, stderr and destination bytes; XLSX and other targets retain their separately recorded references.
